issue: Compound-word / boundary splitting (e.g. SOUTHWELL -> SOUTH WELL, BEFOREHAND -> BEFORE HAND)
scope: EM-False, recurring across homophone and non-homophone rows
recommended_fix: Pre-tokenise compounds in the target side; consider a constrained decoder or post-hoc join rule for known compound lists.

issue: Digit / word number rendering mismatch (SIX <-> 6, TEN <-> 10)
evidence_value: 17 of 949 hyps contain a digit; 4 of 76 EM-False hyps use digits when ref used words
scope: Phonetically correct; fails on orthographic convention only
recommended_fix: Post-process: convert digit tokens to spelled-out words or vice-versa to match the reference convention.

issue: Proper-noun / rare-word OOV substitutions (WALDORF -> WALLDORF, SAXIFRAGE -> SAXOPHONE FRAGMENT)
scope: EM-False slice; vocabulary coverage gap rather than acoustic failure
recommended_fix: Expand CMU dictionary coverage via g2p fallback (already wired through data.g2p); allow free generation rather than forcing closest CMU word.

scope: Phoneme level; 14 of 38 EM-False subs = 'Vowel' label (36.84%)
recommended_fix: Feature-aware rescoring does NOT help (vowels share place & manner; only length distinguishes). Retrain with vowel-length augmentation or use a duration-aware acoustic model.

issue: Casing artefacts inflate CER but have no research signal
recommended_fix: Lowercase all hypotheses before CER computation, or upper-case all references — pick a single convention. Already mitigated by CER-vs-WER comparison.

issue: Suffix hallucination and space-insertion (SHIPPING for SHIP, ROPE S for ROPES)
recommended_fix: Constrained decoding that penalises intra-word space insertion; subword-tokeniser fix if the issue persists at BPE level.

scope: Mostly correct; the failure is that reference uses one form and hypothesis uses the other
recommended_fix: Upstream: pick canonical form at training time. Downstream: no fix without breaking other usage; BERTScore already shows these are semantically equivalent.

issue: BERTScore F1 is high even on EM-False: 52.6% above 0.90
recommended_fix: Reporting: WER/CER overstates the practical error magnitude for lip-reading. Use BERTScore or human-rated utility alongside WER.

evidence_value: 0 of 85 substitutions escalated by Option-3 grammar rule
scope: Specific: NONE of the {n_homophone_subs} homophone subs in dedup beam-5 trigger a closed-class role mismatch
recommended_fix: Corpus contains no (THEIR/THERE) or (YOUR/YORE) misuse; the grammar detector is correctly armed but unused. Keep it for production runs.

scope: EM-False slice; indicates decoder emission without dictionary constraint
recommended_fix: Constrained decoding over CMU vocabulary; or learn a spell-correction post-net trained on homophone-pairs.
